cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Deferred-rendering G-buffer foliage/hair cutouts and smooth camera-distance LOD cross-fade dissolves
Shadow-map alpha-test stippling where full order-independent transparency (OIT) is prohibitively expensive
Explaining why uncorrelated white-noise sin-hashes form Poisson clumps and voids on small 4x4 screen tiles
Combining 4x4 bit-interleaved spatial stratification with Roberts R2 / golden-ratio temporal frame rotation for TAA accumulation
not_for: Forward-rendered glass or refractive surfaces where hardware premultiplied alpha blending is available
Pipelines with Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA) disabled where high-frequency stipple dots remain un-accumulated at 1x resolution
Neural portrait/video alpha matting models (ViTMatte / Robust Video Matting)
Fully opaque non-dissolving meshes where alpha ≡ 1.0 requires zero discard tests
